held.title: New resolution pins mermaid's URL sanitizer to 7.0.1, which may downgrade it.
held.body: The new resolution `"mermaid/@braintree/sanitize-url": "7.0.1"` forces the URL sanitizer that mermaid depends on to one exact version. The pull request never says why. Mermaid uses this library to clean link and click URLs that come from untrusted README diagram source. I believe mermaid 11.x declares `^7.1.x`, but I could not check that or the yarn.lock change from here. If it does, this override silently downgrades the sanitizer below what mermaid expects. That can bring back URL-sanitizing bugs fixed in later versions, or break mermaid if it relies on newer behaviour. Remove the override so mermaid gets the version it asks for, or explain why it is pinned and confirm 7.0.1 meets mermaid's declared range.
